items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: Chambon, piano, drums, there wasn't no saxophones in them days.

ctx.x: Chambon, piano, drums, there wasn't no saxophones in them days. Drums and plankton, banjos and like that. Okay. guitars, violins, so forth.
Did they have a clarinet then? Were they out?
